arxiv-2111-04589.creator: Vincent Cohen-AddadAnupam GuptaLunjia Hu, Hoon OhDavid Saulpic
arxiv-2111-04589.description: Abstract We present a new local-search algorithm for the k k -median clustering problem. We show that local optima for this algorithm give a ( 2.836 + ϵ ) (2.836+\epsilon) -approximation; our result improves upon the ( 3 + ϵ ) (3+\epsilon) -approximate local-search algorithm of Arya et al. [ AGK+01 ] .

arxiv-2207-12540.title: Theia : science cases and mission profiles for high precision astrometry in the future
arxiv-2207-12540.creator: Fabien Malbet, Lucas Labadie, Alessandro Sozzetti, Gary A. Mamon, Mike Shao, Renaud Goullioud, Alain Léger, Mario Gai, Alberto Riva, Deborah Busonero, Thierry Lépine, Manon Lizzana, Alexis Brandeker, Eva Villaver
arxiv-2207-12540.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Fabien Malbet, Lucas Labadie, Alessandro Sozzetti, Gary A. Mamon, Mike Shao, Renaud Goullioud, Alain Léger, Mario Gai, Alberto Riva, Deborah Busonero, Thierry Lépine, Manon Lizzana, Alexis Brandeker, Eva Villaver. High-precision astrometry well beyond the capacities of Gaia will provide a unique way to achieve astrophysical breakthroughs, in particular on the nature of dark matter, and a complete survey of nearby habitable exoplanets.

arxiv-2209-13343.title: Semigroup intersection problems in the Heisenberg groups
arxiv-2209-13343.creator: Ruiwen Dong
arxiv-2209-13343.description: Abstract We consider two algorithmic problems concerning sub-semigroups of Heisenberg groups and, more generally, two-step nilpotent groups. The first problem is Intersection Emptiness , which asks whether a finite number of given finitely generated semigroups have empty intersection. This problem was first studied by Markov in the 1940s.

arxiv-2306-11264.title: GraphGLOW: Universal and Generalizable Structure Learning for Graph Neural Networks Conference: Proceedings of the 29th ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining; August 6–10, 2023; Long Beach, CA, USA Proceedings of the 29th ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data M
arxiv-2306-11264.creator: Wentao Zhao, Qitian Wu, Chenxiao Yang, Junchi Yan
arxiv-2306-11264.description: Abstract . Graph structure learning is a well-established problem that aims at optimizing graph structures adaptive to specific graph datasets to help message passing neural networks (i.e., GNNs) to yield effective and robust node embeddings. However, the common limitation of existing models lies in the underlying closed-world assumption : the testing graph is the same as the training graph.

arxiv-2310-01394.description: Abstract . An ordered r r -matching of size n n is an r r -uniform hypergraph on a linearly ordered set of vertices, consisting of n n pairwise disjoint edges. Two ordered r r -matchings are isomorphic if there is an order-preserving isomorphism between them.

arxiv-2311-05904.title: A cross-bispectrum estimator for CMB-H i intensity mapping correlations
arxiv-2311-05904.creator: Kavilan Moodley 1,2, Warren Naidoo 1, Heather Prince 1,3,4, Aurelie Penin 1
arxiv-2311-05904.description: Abstract Intensity mapping of 21cm emission from neutral hydrogen (H i ) promises to be a powerful probe of large-scale structure in the post-reionisation epoch. However, H i intensity mapping (IM) experiments will suffer the loss of long-wavelength line-of-sight H i modes in the galactic foreground subtraction process.

arxiv-2405-01243.title: Multimodal reconstruction of TbCo thin film structure with Basyeian analysis of polarised neutron reflectivity
arxiv-2405-01243.creator: P.S. Savchenkov 1,2 , K.V. Nikolaev 1,3 , V.I. Bodnarchuk 1,4,5 , A.N. Pirogov 6 , A.V. Belushkin 1,4,7 and S.N. Yakunin
arxiv-2405-01243.description: Abstract We implemented the Bayesian analysis to the polarised neutron reflectivity data. Reflectivity data from a magnetic TbCo thin film structure was studied using the bundle of a Monte-Carlo Markov-chain algorithm, likelihood estimation, and error modeling. By utilizing the Bayesian analysis, we were able to investigate the uniqueness of the solution beyond reconstructing the magnetic and structure parameters.

arxiv-2502-18939.title: A Novel Topology Recovery Method for Low Voltage Distribution Networks This paper is accepted for presentation in 2025 IEEE PES General Meeting.
arxiv-2502-18939.creator: Sina Mohammadi, Van-Hai Bui, Wencong Su
arxiv-2502-18939.description: Abstract Low voltage distribution networks (LVDNs) suffer from limited visibility due to sparse or nonexistent measurement systems, leaving distribution network service providers with incomplete data. Maintenance activities, such as transformer upgrades and power line replacements, sometimes go undocumented, leading to unmonitored topology changes.

arxiv-2509-13072.title: Digital Sovereignty Control Framework for Military AI-based Cyber Security
arxiv-2509-13072.creator: Clara Maathuis 1 , Kasper Cools 2 3
arxiv-2509-13072.description: Abstract In today’s evolving threat landscape, ensuring digital sovereignty has become mandatory for military organizations, especially given their increased development and investment in AI-driven cyber security solutions. To this end, a multi-angled framework is proposed in this article in order to define and assess digital sovereign control of data and AI-based models for military cyber security.

pmc-10517949.title: The social relevance and the temporal constraints of motor resonance in humans
pmc-10517949.creator: Giacomo Guidali, Michela Picardi, Maria Franca, Antonio Caronni, Nadia Bolognini
pmc-10517949.description: In humans, motor resonance effects can be tracked by measuring the enhancement of corticospinal excitability by action observation. Uncovering factors driving motor resonance is crucial for optimizing action observation paradigms in experimental and clinical settings. In the present study, we deepen motor resonance properties for grasping movements.

pmc-10681543.title: A unified DNA‐ and RNA‐based NGS strategy for the analysis of multiple types of variants at the dual nucleic acid level in solid tumors
pmc-10681543.creator: Huijuan Chen, Bing Wang, Yiran Zhang, Yingshuang Shu, Henan Dong, Qian Zhao, Chunyan Yang, Jianji Li, Xiaohong Duan, Qiming Zhou
pmc-10681543.description: BackgroundTargeted next‐generation sequencing (NGS) is a powerful and suitable approach to comprehensively identify multiple types of variants in tumors. RNA‐based NGS is increasingly playing an important role in precision oncology. Both parallel and sequential DNA‐ and RNA‐based approaches are expensive, burdensome, and have long turnaround times, which can be impractical in clinical practice.

pmc-10738669.title: CREATIVE ACTIVITIES AND COGNITION AMONG OLDER ADULTS: DOES EDUCATION MODERATE THE BENEFITS OF CREATIVE ACTIVITIES?
pmc-10738669.creator: Janelle Fassi
pmc-10738669.description: Engagement in leisure activities has been shown to offset age-related cognitive losses. Although activity engagement has a compensatory effect on later life cognition among adults with low educational levels in early life, no studies have examined this effect with creative activity engagement.

pmc-11352875.title: Comparison of Diagnostic Parameters of Acute Coronary Syndromes in Patients with and without Cancer: A Multifactorial Analysis
pmc-11352875.creator: Anna Ciołek, Grzegorz Piotrowski
pmc-11352875.description: Background: The simultaneous occurrence of cancer and acute coronary syndromes (ACSs) presents a complex clinical challenge. This study clarifies variances in diagnostic parameters among ACS patients with and without concurrent cancer. Methods: This retrospective study included 320 individuals diagnosed with ACS, stratified equally into two cohorts—one with cancer and the other cancer-free.

pmc-11679729.title: Microbiological Evaluation of Local and Imported Raw Beef Meat at Retail Sites in Oman with Emphasis on Spoilage and Pathogenic Psychrotrophic Bacteria
pmc-11679729.creator: Musallam A. Al-Mazrouei, Zahra S. Al-Kharousi, Jamila M. Al-Kharousi, Hajer M. Al-Barashdi
pmc-11679729.description: Determining the microbial quality and safety of meat is crucial because of its high potential to harbor pathogens. To address the critical knowledge gap and shed light on potential contamination risk in the meat supply chain, this study aimed to assess the underexplored microbial quality and safety of marketed beef meat in Oman.

pmc-12539226.title: Dislocated Dual-Mobility Hip Implants Are Unlikely to Be Successfully Closed Reduced and Are More Likely to Require Revision Than Standard Articulation Implants
pmc-12539226.creator: Janyne Mallender, Kendall Schwartz, Christian Leber, Tony Huyhn, Paulo Castaneda, J Brock Walker
pmc-12539226.description: BackgroundThe natural history of dislocated dual-mobility (DM) total hip arthroplasties remains unclear, particularly regarding closed reduction success and revision rates compared to standard articulations (SAs). This study compared closed reduction success and subsequent reoperation rates between dislocated DM and SA hips.

pmc-12590326.title: Re‐Evaluating the Demographic History of, and Inferring the Fine‐Scale Recombination Landscape For, Wild Chinese Rhesus Macaques (Macaca mulatta)
pmc-12590326.creator: John W. Terbot, Adriana Calahorra‐Oliart, Cyril J. Versoza, Devangana Shah, Vivak Soni, Susanne P. Pfeifer, Jeffrey D. Jensen
pmc-12590326.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). As a major model for biomedical research, the rhesus macaque (Macaca mulatta) is one of the most important and heavily studied nonhuman primates. Despite this importance, the level of population structure and subspecific division in this species remains relatively unclear; for example, the number of proposed subspecies in the literature ranges from one to six within China, with additional populations found across India.

pmc-13224691.title: Replication and compartmentalization of Dobrava-Belgrade virus in the central nervous system
pmc-13224691.creator: Julia Melchert, Julia Herzig-Nichtweiss, Jenny Meinhardt, Farid Salih, Till Dominik Best, Marie Luisa Schmidt, Lisa Jasmin Müller, Talitha Veith, Jörn Beheim-Schwarzbach, Jörg Hofmann, Terry C. Jones, Eberhard Siebert, Felix Schoenrath, Helena Radbruch, Christian Drosten, Victor Max Corman
pmc-13224691.description: A heart-transplant recipient developed fatal neurologic disease. High-throughput sequencing (HTS) identified Dobrava – Belgrade virus in central nervous system (CNS) and peripheral specimens. Genomic analyzes showed distinct viral populations across compartments, suggesting CNS tropism. This case highlights atypical infection presentations in immunosuppressed patients and underscores the diagnostic value of HTS.

pmc-13307718.title: Nanotechnology-enhanced CAR-T therapy strategies in cancer, aging, and autoimmune diseases
pmc-13307718.creator: Hongjia Li, Jinxin Li, Xiting Liu, Xueju Wei, Xin Zeng, Qiwei Wang, Yingli Han, He Huang, Pengxu Qian
pmc-13307718.description: Chimeric antigen receptor T-cell (CAR-T) therapy has emerged as a transformative immunotherapy, which achieves remarkable success in hematological malignancies. However, broader application of CAR-T therapy is hindered by multiple challenges, including limited efficacy in solid tumors, antigen escape, severe toxicities, and complex, costly manufacturing. Recent studies have emerged that nanotechnology offers innovative solutions to overcome barriers.

pmc-13436614.title: Advances in Pharmacological Therapy of Benign Tracheal Stenosis: A Meta‐Analysis of Preclinical Studies
pmc-13436614.creator: Dengyuan Li, Jie Zeng, Rufang Li, Rong Wang, Danxiong Sun
pmc-13436614.description: BackgroundBenign tracheal stenosis, characterized by granulation hyperplasia, is a rare and serious disease threatening human health. Interventional bronchoscopy demonstrates limited therapeutic efficacy and poses a risk of re‐injury to the airway. The objective of this meta‐analysis is to evaluate the efficacy of pharmacological therapy in preclinical models of tracheal stenosis.
